== Course of events ==

With the Scarecrow left without his usual stuffing, Tip proposes a solution drawn from what the group has at hand: the nest holds a hoard of money that the Jackdaws had stolen from towns over the years, and Tip suggests this money be used to refill him. The idea is taken up at once, and Tip, the Scarecrow, and the rest of the party set about the work, packing the Scarecrow's form with bills of various denominations from the stolen hoard until he is fully restuffed.
